biggest_catch: Your $5 stays pending until your friend actually shops — they must buy over $5 and earn at least $1 of cashback that reaches 'Available' status, or you get nothing.
catches: Referred friend must be a brand-new Extrabux member; self-referrals are not allowed.
Referral attribution only lasts 7 days after the friend clicks your link.
Your $5 per referral stays pending until the friend buys over $5 and earns at least $1 cashback that becomes 'Available'.
The extra 5%-of-friend's-cashback match runs for one year after the referral.
Cashback payouts require at least $10 of 'Available' cashback plus at least one purchase with earnings exceeding $1; payouts go via check in the mail or PayPal.
Page FAQ states the friend gets a $20 signup bonus.

steps: Create a free Extrabux account and get your referral link.
Share the link with a friend; they must click it and sign up within 7 days of the click.
Your friend gets a $20 signup bonus from Extrabux.
Your friend must make a purchase over $5 and earn at least $1 of cashback that reaches 'Available' status.
Your $5 referral bonus then releases into your account, and you also get 5% of your friend's cashback earnings for the next year.
Once you have at least $10 of Available cashback (and at least one purchase with earnings over $1), request payout via check or PayPal.
timing: Your $5 releases when the friend's cashback becomes Available; requested payouts are typically sent within 5 business days.
